rv.q: Milikowski peels away the layers of the men’s histories as though she’s directing a thriller.
Ken Urban’s ironically titled A Guide for the Homesick is a smart and intriguing piece of theater that not only works as a thriller but also as a commentary on how we live today.
So, here’s to Belcher and Schlesinger for being so effective they two-handedly raise the level of a faltering experiment.
If the journey is occasionally bumpy, the late revelations about the missing characters make the trip worth taking.
